question: Should Crabpot adopt QQBot revision `47142c9` despite the upstream architecture/install changes, or keep the currently validated fixture pin until a compatibility-qualified update is prepared?
rationale: The required outcome depends on the repository’s intended QQBot compatibility contract and acceptable external-plugin upgrade policy, which cannot be selected safely from a Dependabot pointer change alone.

options.title: Require compatibility-qualified update
options.body: Keep the PR open only after it includes or links passing changed-fixture evidence, updated expected reports where needed, and a review of the imported installation change.

options.title: Preserve the validated pin
options.body: Close or supersede this automated bump and retain the current fixture revision until a deliberately reviewed QQBot upgrade is proposed.

recommendation.title: Require compatibility-qualified update
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open only after it includes or links passing changed-fixture evidence, updated expected reports where needed, and a review of the imported installation change.
